title: Masses at the two signs sum to one
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. The probability masses of the points where $f$ equals $1$ and where $f$ equals $-1$ sum to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
